inspiration: Office as a small-prop town: 32 px props placed on a tile grid, with furniture, carts and balloons as ambient life (asset/objects, asset/singleObjects, pics/office.png). Keep the dense small-prop read; change the prop set to our own theme.

Speech bubble as a nine-patch frame: the bubble is a nine-patch background with a word-wrapped pixel label, has a default duration argument of 5.0 seconds (line 39) and a target-side flag (is_target_on_right); the auto-hide and flip bodies were not read (script/ui/DialogBubble.gd lines 15, 26, 39). Recreate with our own frame and a tail that points at the speaker.

Arrival ease: the walk speed lerps from 40 percent to full over the last 50 px before the target, so the character slows into the spot (script/CharacterController.gd line 274). Keep the ease-out; add a settle pose on arrival.

Direction-keyed clips: one clip name per state and facing (idle, run, sit, stand) for four directions (script/CharacterController.gd lines 46, 343-409). Keep the clip-per-facing pattern; change the set to add a three-quarter facing and a look-around idle.

Ambient animated props: short looping 32 px props (party balloons in four colours, carts, a TV, a hospital door) give a room life without characters moving (asset/objects/animated_*). Recreate the loop set with fire, lanterns and a flicker.

Portrait and body pairs: each persona has a face portrait for the dialogue card and a body sheet for the world view (asset/characters/portraits and body). Keep the pair; change the portrait to a two-tone palette with a class emblem.
Persona table keyed by name: one constant holds a config per named persona (script/CharacterPersonality.gd line 6). Good shape for a data-driven roster with a per-persona voice and look.

briefs.label: Nine-patch speech bubble
briefs.why: A short line reads at phone width without a full panel, and it leaves on its own.
briefs.keep: nine-patch frame; default duration argument of 5 seconds; a target-side flag
briefs.change: a tail that points at the speaker; the text reveals one word at a time; our own pixel font

briefs.label: Arrival ease
briefs.why: Slowing into a target looks deliberate and avoids a hard stop.
briefs.keep: speed eases from a low fraction to full over the last stretch before the target
briefs.change: a settle pose on arrival (a small dip and a shift of weight); the ease length depends on the stance

briefs.label: Lantern loop props
briefs.why: Looping small props make a room feel alive with no character movement.
briefs.keep: 32 px props on a loop; a set of colour variants of the same prop
briefs.change: fire, lantern and torch flicker instead of balloons and carts; loops offset in time so no two match

briefs.label: Persona card pair
briefs.why: A face card for talk and a body sprite for the world lets one character read in two places.
briefs.keep: portrait and body as a pair per persona
briefs.change: two-tone portrait palette; a class emblem in the corner; body sprite proportions set per class
